zh-Hans.subtitle: 本地AI分类与相册整理
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 用 Gemma 2 在设备端快速分类照片，按你的习惯编辑内置规则和自定义类别。支持相似照片查找、滑动多选及文本诊断导出；已有分类不会因更新自动改变。
zh-Hans.description:
ImagePilot 是一款本地优先的照片与视频整理工具，帮助你按内容和文件信息浏览相册、查找相似照片并整理收藏。

【选择适合自己的 AI 模型】
支持本地 AI 分类，提供 Gemma 2 快速分类等模型选项。Gemma 2 用于图片语义分类，不生成图片描述。部分模型需要先联网下载，下载完成后可在设备端识别照片。也可自行配置在线模型服务；只有选择在线服务进行处理时，相关图片才会发送至该服务。不同模型的能力和速度会有所不同。

【让分类规则适合你的相册】
使用人物、宠物、美食、风景、建筑、植物、文档等内置分类，或创建自己的类别。可编辑内置规则、补充画面场景和排除条件，并恢复默认。自然语言规则适用于支持该能力的模型，固定标签模型不支持。修改规则不会自动改变已经整理好的照片，需主动重新分类才应用新规则。

【更方便地浏览和整理】
按内容、城市、颜色及文件信息浏览；查找相似照片，长按滑动连续选择多张照片。使用暂存箱集中检查待处理照片，再确认删除或归档。

【照片与视频一起管理】
支持视频分类。初次识别为“其他”时，可从不同位置补取视频帧再次识别。可查看分类匹配详情，并导出文本诊断用于反馈问题。

【时刻、报告与编辑】
回顾照片中的时刻与回忆，制作时刻秀和相册报告；使用修图、滤镜和相关本地编辑工具处理照片。

【数据由你管理】
提供分类索引备份与恢复。使用本地模型分类时，推理在设备上完成；使用你配置的在线服务时，相关图片按该服务的处理方式传输。模型下载及在线功能需要网络。

AI 分类可能出现误判，你可以调整分类规则或手动修改分类。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
• 修复长按照片进入多选时列表跳回顶部、拖动多选中断的问题。
• 优化连续多选和边缘自动滚动，减少手势中的布局变化及缩略图重绘。

本次更新带来更灵活的本地 AI 分类和更清晰的整理体验。

• Gemma 2 快速分类：新增本地快速分类模型选项，模型下载后可在设备端处理照片，分类无需上传图片。
• 优化分类判断：按最高有效类别分数选择结果，匹配度不足时归入“其他”；完善风景、人物、植物、商品等内置规则，减少背景元素干扰。
• 分类规则由你调整：支持编辑内置分类规则、自定义类别、补充场景与排除项，并可恢复内置默认规则。改善自定义场景与原始规则的匹配。
• 优化运动健身规则：移除默认游泳匹配项，改善湖泊、河流和急流场景的分类。
• 更方便地反馈问题：可查看分类匹配详情，并将完整诊断导出为 TXT 文本文件。
• 改善视频分类：初次归入“其他”时，尝试补取不同位置的视频帧进行识别。
• 更顺手的相册操作：支持长按滑动连续多选，完善分类索引及规则的备份与恢复兼容性。
• 设置界面更清晰：重新整理功能分组、统一小图标及展开/收起箭头；修图预设使用明确的“编辑”按钮，优化触控区域和读屏名称。iOS 相册权限、相似度阈值与 AI 搜索索引默认展开显示。
• 保留已有整理成果：更新及修改规则不会自动改变已有照片分类；主动重新分类后才应用新规则。

AI 分类可能出现误判，可手动调整结果。

en-US.subtitle: Local AI photo organizer
en-US.promotionalText: Classify photos on-device with Gemma 2, customize category rules, find similar photos and select with a drag. Existing classifications stay in place when you update.
en-US.description:
ImagePilot is a local-first photo and video organizer. Browse your library by content and file information, find similar photos, and keep your collection organized.

CHOOSE YOUR AI MODEL
Use on-device AI classification with options including Gemma 2 fast classification. Gemma 2 classifies image content; it does not generate image descriptions. Some local models require an initial download; image recognition then runs on your device. You can also configure an online model provider. Images processed with an online service are sent to that provider. Model capabilities and speed vary.

MAKE CATEGORIES YOUR OWN
Use built-in categories for people, pets, food, scenery, buildings, plants, documents, and more, or create custom categories. Edit built-in rules, add visual scenarios and exclusions, and restore defaults. Natural-language rules work with supported models, not fixed-label models. Editing a rule does not automatically change existing classifications; choose reclassification to apply it.

BROWSE AND ORGANIZE
Browse by content, city, color, and file information. Find similar photos and select consecutive items with a long press and drag. Collect items in the staging box for review before confirming deletion or archiving.

MANAGE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Classify videos as well as photos. Videos initially classified as Other can be retried with additional frames. View matching details and export text diagnostics when reporting a problem.

MEMORIES, REPORTS AND EDITING
Revisit moments and memories, create Showtime reels and album reports, and use photo-editing tools and filters.

MANAGE YOUR DATA
Back up and restore your classification index. Local-model inference runs on your device. When you choose your configured online service, the relevant images are transmitted for processing by that service. Model downloads and online features require a network connection.

AI classification may be incorrect. You can adjust category rules or change a classification manually.
en-US.whatsNew:
• Fixed the photo list jumping to the top and drag selection being interrupted after a long press.
• Improved range selection and edge scrolling, with fewer layout shifts and thumbnail redraws.

This update brings more flexible on-device AI classification and a clearer photo-organizing experience.

• Gemma 2 fast classification: a new local model option processes photos on your device after the model download, without uploading photos for classification.
• Improved category matching: choose the highest-scoring eligible category and use Other when matching is insufficient. Refined scenery, people, plants, products and other built-in rules to reduce background distractions.
• Editable category rules: customize built-in rules, create categories, add scenarios and exclusions, or restore built-in defaults. Improved how custom scenarios work with the original rule.
• Refined Sports & Fitness rules: removed default swimming matches to improve classification of lakes, rivers and rapids.
• Easier troubleshooting: inspect matching details and export complete diagnostics as a TXT file.
• Improved video classification: videos initially assigned to Other can be retried using frames from additional positions.
• Easier library management: long-press and drag to select consecutive items, plus improved compatibility for classification-index and rule backups.
• Clearer settings: reorganized feature groups, consistent icons and expand/collapse arrows, explicit Edit buttons for editing presets, and improved touch targets and accessibility labels. Photo access, similarity thresholds and the AI search index are expanded by default on iOS.
• Existing classifications are preserved. Updating the app or editing rules does not automatically reclassify your photos; reclassify them when you want to apply the new rules.

AI results may be incorrect and can be adjusted manually.
